abstract: OBJECTIVE: The aim of the current study was to investigate levels of placenta growth factor in the tissues and sera of the patients with gestational trophoblastic disease and to determine its usefulness for the treatment of gestational trophoblastic disease. STUDY DESIGN: Placenta growth factor concentrations were measured in the tissue homogenates of 12 normal placentas, 33 complete hydatidiform moles, and 6 gestational choriocarcinomas. Serum placenta growth factor levels were determined in 59 women with normal pregnant course, in 30 women with complete hydatidiform mole, in 36 women with persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, and 100 nonpregnant healthy volunteers. RESULTS: Serum and tissue placenta growth factor levels in the patients with mole tended to be decreased compared with the levels in normal pregnancy; the levels were increased significantly in patients with choriocarcinoma. When serum placenta growth factor levels were >20 pg/mL (normal upper limit in nonpregnant women), placenta growth factor-to-human chorionic gonadotropin ratios were increased significantly in patients with persistent gestational trophoblastic disease. CONCLUSION: Serum placenta growth factor levels are not of any predictive value in patients with hydatidiform mole. However, elevated serum placenta growth factor levels with increased placenta growth factor-to-human chorionic gonadotropin ratios are suggestive of persistent gestational trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: 目的：妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者における組織および血清中の胎盤増殖因子のレベルを調べ、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の治療における有用性を明らかにすること。研究デザイン：正常胎盤12例、完全胞状奇胎33例、妊娠性絨毛癌6例の組織ホモジネートで胎盤増殖因子の濃度を測定した。血清中の胎盤増殖因子レベルは、正常妊娠の女性59例、完全胞状奇胎の女性30例、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の女性36例、非妊娠の健康なボランティア100例で測定した。結果：奇胎患者の血清および組織中の胎盤増殖因子レベルは、正常妊娠と比べて低下する傾向があった。絨毛癌患者では有意に上昇していた。血清胎盤増殖因子レベルが20 pg/mL（非妊娠女性の正常上限）を超えた場合、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者では胎盤増殖因子とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンの比が有意に上昇していた。結論：奇胎患者では、血清胎盤増殖因子レベルに予測的価値はない。しかし、血清胎盤増殖因子レベルの上昇と、胎盤増殖因子/ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン比の上昇は、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患を示唆する。
